text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While waiting endlessly for Bamboo Memory, who hadn't shown up for training—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'M SOOOO SORRYYYY!!!
Trainer!! For being late!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Getting so caught up in a hot-blooded drama that I showed up late...!
100 laps around the track!!
A folly deserving of 100 written apologies...!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The disciplinary committee is supposed to keep watch for latecomers!
And yet, and yet... I'm the one who's...!
choice_data_list: Just the thought is more than enough.
Just the thought is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Kh... What incredible broad-mindedness...!
It just makes me hate how petty I am even more!
Now that it's come to this——

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
1,000 laps around the track!!
Make it a 1,000-page reflection essay instead, pleeease!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Bamboo Memory was deeply remorseful,
I told her not to be too hard on herself.
